# Example

> Example builds tools for agents.

## For agents

- [API](https://api.example.com/v1): every operation.
- [Sign in as an agent](https://example.com/auth.md): a wallet with no person, the device flow (`hanzo auth login`), API keys, and OpenID Connect at hanzo.id.
